title: Read the Regime
briefing: Lumen Bikes will trend, then chop, then break down. Your strategy has to change with it. Sitting out is allowed.
objective: Match the strategy to the regime: trend following in trends, small or no size in chop, cash in a breakdown.
debrief: For the first twelve days Lumen Bikes made higher highs and lows: a trend. From day 12 the average flattened and price chopped back and forth, punishing anyone who kept trading signals. From day 24 lower lows and the weak consumer-spending report sent it into a breakdown. A disciplined player rode the trend, stepped aside in the chop and stayed in cash through the breakdown.
